name: Railyug Standard Passenger Protection & Railway Transit Rules
disclaimer: SIMULATED DATA ONLY - NOT OFFICIAL IRCTC POLICY. FOR JOURNEY RESILIENCE ASSISTANCE DEMO.

mandatoryLinkPairs.errorMessage: Caregiver violation: Passenger P1 (Senior Citizen with mobility constraint) cannot be separated from caregiver P2 under any itinerary.

childProtection.errorMessage: Child protection violation: Passenger P3 (child under five) must be accompanied by at least one eligible adult guardian (P2 or P5).

P1.errorMessage: Accessibility constraint failed: Selected route lacks step-free access or exceeds P1 walking endurance limit.

moreThan48HoursBeforeDeparture.description: Flat cancellation charge per passenger if cancelled >48 hrs before departure.

between12And48HoursBeforeDeparture.description: 25% of fare subject to minimum flat cancellation charge.

between4And12HoursBeforeDeparture.description: 50% of fare subject to minimum flat cancellation charge before chart prep.

lessThan4HoursOrAfterChartPrep.description: No refund permissible after chart preparation under standard cancellation rules.

priorToChartPreparation.description: Full refund minus standard clerkage fee of ₹60 per passenger.

autoCancellationOnChartRegret.description: Fully waitlisted e-tickets dropped at chart preparation are refunded automatically minus clerkage.

trainCancelledByRailway.description: 100% full refund with zero cancellation or clerkage fees when train is officially cancelled by Indian Railways.

missedConnectionDueToLateRunningTrain.description: Full refund for untravelled leg when passenger misses connecting train due to official late arrival of originating train (TDR reason: Missed Connection).
